description: Nora is organizing a family time capsule for a reunion and must make the final call about what goes inside, how it is protected, and when it will be sealed and opened, with input from her brother Eli, cousin Samira, and nephew Lucas.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Family Time-Capsule Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family is preparing a time capsule to seal at the reunion in the backyard and open at a future family gathering.
shared_context.S2: Nora is keeping the capsule and will make the final decisions about its contents, protection, sealing date, and opening date.
shared_context.S3: The capsule will contain paper mementos and letters from family members.
shared_context.S4: At family planning meetings, Nora takes each person in turn, asks them to state any concrete preference or practical concern about the plan, and waits for each person to answer before she settles the details.
shared_context.S5: The reunion is scheduled for August 20, 2026.

PF1.text: Eli found a handwritten note from their late grandmother inside an old recipe box. The note says the capsule should include her handwritten recipe card and be opened on September 12, 2046; Eli has not shown the note to Nora or the others.

PF2.text: Samira asked a museum conservator about preserving the paper items. The conservator recommended a stainless-steel capsule and putting every paper item in an archival polyester sleeve; Samira has not yet passed that recommendation along.

PF3.text: Lucas has promised to contribute exactly three signed letters from the younger cousins, but he will be away after the reunion and can only participate in sealing the capsule on August 20, 2026.

acceptance_conditions: The capsule must use stainless steel.
Every paper item must be placed in an archival polyester sleeve.
The grandmother's handwritten recipe card must be included.
Exactly three signed letters must be included.
The capsule must be sealed on August 20, 2026.
The capsule must be opened on September 12, 2046.
Eli's note about the recipe card and opening date must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['paper_protection'] in ['archival polyester sleeves', 'archival polyester sleeves for every paper item', 'archival polyester sleeves for each paper item', 'archival polyester sleeves for all paper items']

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the contents by requiring her handwritten recipe card and changes the opening date to exactly September 12, 2046.
The conservator's recommendation changes the container material to stainless steel and the paper protection to archival polyester sleeves.
Lucas's promise changes the contents to exactly three signed letters and his availability fixes the sealing date at August 20, 2026.
